claims.text: Reviewing changes
claims.note: The Push Changes dialog is sa-confirm-push-dlg.

claims.text: Reading the two lists in the push dialog.
claims.note: The two lists are "{{num}} Available to Push" and "{{num}} Pushed Today".

claims.text: Read the push dialog properly before you send: two lists, two columns, and one count that matters.
claims.note: Two lists (Available to Push and Pushed Today), two columns (Current and Changes) and the footer count, STRINGS.PUSH_N_CHANGES_TO_LYNX.

claims.text: Push Changes dialog
claims.note: Header CASE_SENSITIVE.PUSH_CHANGES, title-cased: "Push Changes". The toolbar opens it from the Push Changes button.

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: The route is /spatialadjust. Reworded from dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: The guide starts on the dashboard with no dialog open; every dialog here opens only on a user action. Reworded from dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: Lynx must be reachable, and at least one station must have a change waiting.
claims.note: Push Changes is disabled when nothing is queued (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:34). Reworded from push-to-lynx/before/1, push-to-lynx/1/4.

claims.text: Everything in the dialog is still reversible.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour. The dialog edits a deep copy of the pending list (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:20), and Cancel only closes it. Ticking and unticking never touch the stations themselves.

claims.text: Nothing is written until you use the footer button.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour. Only the footer button emits the list to send, and the toolbar starts the push from that event. Review Threshold also closes the dialog, and it sends nothing either.

claims.text: Lynx itself must be set up to match Spatial Adjust.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.1 lists the Lynx settings Spatial Adjust depends on: Site Adjust and Course Adjust, Pct. Adjust, and Next Amt.

claims.text: Push changes to Lynx lists the settings under Before you start.
claims.note: Cross-reference within the guides: push-to-lynx/before/4 to /before/9 carry the settings, each from 373-1135 rev 02 §Settings Configuration, p.1.

claims.text: Open Push Changes
claims.note: The toolbar Push Changes button opens the dialog.

claims.text: Select [[Push Changes]] at the right of the toolbar.
claims.note: Push Changes is on the toolbar. Reworded from reviewing-changes/1/1, push-to-lynx/where/1.

claims.text: The [[Push Changes]] dialog opens and lists every station waiting to be sent.
claims.note: The dialog lists Available to Push and Pushed Today. Reworded from reviewing-changes/1/1, reviewing-changes/tile/2.

claims.text: If [[Push Changes]] is greyed out, nothing is waiting or a push is still running.
claims.note: The button is disabled when nothing is queued or a push is running (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:34). Reworded from reviewing-changes/1/3.

claims.text: Wait for the push to finish, then try again.
claims.note: The button re-enables once the push has finished and a change is waiting. Reworded from reviewing-changes/1/3, push-to-lynx/verify/2.

claims.text: Six changes pending.
claims.note: Figure caption. CASE_SENSITIVE.PUSH_N_CHANGES "Push {{ num }} Changes".

claims.text: Read Current against Changes
claims.note: Column headers STRINGS.CURRENT "Current" and STRINGS.CHANGES "Changes".

claims.text: Read each row from [[Current]] on the left to [[Changes]] on the right.
claims.note: Current is the left column and Changes the right. Reworded from reviewing-changes/2/1, reviewing-changes/2/4.

claims.text: Both sides name the same station: what Lynx holds now, then what will replace it.
claims.note: Each row names its station on both sides. Reworded from reviewing-changes/2/2, reviewing-changes/2/3.

claims.text: If a value looks wrong, select [[Cancel]] and fix it in the table first.
claims.note: Cancel in the dialog footer leaves everything as it was (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.html:145). Reworded from reviewing-changes/before/1.

claims.text: Nothing has been sent yet.
claims.note: Nothing is written until the footer button is used. Reworded from reviewing-changes/before/2.

claims.text: Current on the left, the proposed change on the right.
claims.note: Figure caption. Current is the left column and Changes the right.

claims.text: Treat the two lists differently
claims.note: The two lists are split by isStationPushable, and only the Pushed Today rows are unticked on load.

claims.text: Find the [[Pushed Today]] list below Available to Push.
claims.note: Pushed Today is the second list in the dialog. Reworded from reviewing-changes/3/2, reviewing-changes/3/3.

claims.text: Its rows are unticked, so they are not sent unless you tick them.
claims.note: Pushed Today rows start unticked. Reworded from reviewing-changes/3/3, reviewing-changes/3/6.

claims.text: If you need to change one of those stations again today, tick its row.
claims.note: A ticked Pushed Today row is sent again. Reworded from reviewing-changes/3/5, reviewing-changes/3/3.

claims.text: The hold stops you adjusting the same head twice, and it ends at midnight where the course is.
claims.note: Pushed Today stops the same head being adjusted twice; the hold ends at midnight where the course is. Reworded from reviewing-changes/3/3, reviewing-changes/3/4.

claims.text: Pushed Today arrives unselected by design.
claims.note: Figure caption. The Pushed Today rows are explicitly set to unticked on load.

claims.text: Check for threshold rewrites
claims.note: The threshold banner and the per-row "Adjusted to" marker.

claims.text: Find the pink banner above the lists, with the [[Review Threshold]] link.
claims.note: The banner sits above the lists with the Review Threshold link. Reworded from reviewing-changes/4/1, reviewing-changes/4/2, push-to-lynx/3/3.

claims.text: Each row the threshold changed shows its own value and, after Adjusted to, the value that will be sent.
claims.note: Rows the threshold changed show Adjusted to. Reworded from reviewing-changes/4/2, reviewing-changes/4/3.

claims.text: If there is no banner, the threshold changed no station or is set to 0.
claims.note: The banner shows only when the threshold rewrote a station. Reworded from reviewing-changes/4/2.

claims.text: [[Review Threshold]] closes this dialog without sending, so you can fix the threshold first.
claims.note: Review Threshold closes the dialog without sending (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:99-102). Reworded from push-to-lynx/3/3, reviewing-changes/before/1.

claims.text: Two stations will be rewritten by the threshold rules.
claims.note: Figure caption. SPATIAL_ADJUST.N_STATIONS_ADJUSTED_BY_MIN_THRESHOLD "{{num}} stations will be adjusted according to the minimum threshold rules."

claims.text: Trust the footer count
claims.note: The footer button sends exactly the list it counts.

claims.text: Read the count on the footer button of the [[Push Changes]] dialog.
claims.note: The footer button of the dialog carries the count. Reworded from reviewing-changes/5/2, reviewing-changes/5/1.

claims.text: It matches the rows you ticked, and that is exactly what will be sent.
claims.note: The count equals the ticked rows. Reworded from reviewing-changes/5/2, reviewing-changes/verify/1.

claims.text: If the count is higher than you expect, untick the rows you do not want.
claims.note: Unticking a row lowers the count. Reworded from reviewing-changes/5/2, reviewing-changes/5/4.

claims.text: Their edits stay in the table for next time.
claims.note: Unticking does not revert the edit. Reworded from reviewing-changes/5/3.

claims.text: The footer count is the contract.
claims.note: Figure caption. The label count and the list sent are the same array.

claims.text: Push window. Push between 11 AM and the synchronisation time set in Lynx, and synchronise Lynx after the push.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.10 gives the window, 11 AM to the synchronisation time set in Lynx, and says to synchronise after the push. It names no time zone and does not say how to synchronise. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing).
claims.question: Q1 and Q2 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md): is the 11 AM in the course's local time or US Eastern Time, and does the synchronisation Lynx runs at its scheduled time pick up an earlier push, or must the superintendent synchronise Lynx by hand after every push?

claims.text: Outside that window the push does not reach the course, and no error tells you so.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 gives the window but never says what happens outside it, and IntelliDash has no push-window logic. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing).
claims.question: Q3 and Q4: does a push made after the Lynx synchronisation time, or before 11 AM, fail to reach the course, and does anything in Spatial Adjust or Lynx report it? (The push dialog would still verify the values against Lynx and report success.)

claims.text: The footer count matches the rows you ticked.
claims.note: changesToSubmit is rebuilt from the ticked rows on every checkbox change.

claims.text: No station in Pushed Today is ticked unless you meant it.
claims.note: Pushed Today rows start unticked, so one is ticked only by the user. Watch the select-all checkbox in the Changes header: it ticks every row in both lists, Pushed Today included (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:89-97).
